## What is Golden Blitz in Monopoly Go?

Golden Blitz is a trading event on Monopoly Go which usually lasts for about 15-24 hours during that time there are two golden stickers which the game allows you to trade. Usually the two stickers change each event, and sometimes the same stickers are repeated for inclusion in the event at a later date during the course of the season. [...] The winning stickers, and the ones to be featured in the next Golden Blitz on Monopoly GO are Honey, I'm Home (Set 13) and Rudy Root (set 14) in this event that runs for 24 hours.

Please check back soon, as we will continue to update this page with any news when we get it.

Head to our Monopoly Go Facebook community if you would like to plan any trades.

Community Golden Blitz

Community Golden Blitz [...] During the Monopoly Origins season, gold stickers can be found in any of the normal packs, there are no golden packs this season. However the drop rate for gold stickers is low and will be different for each star value of card and each star level of pack. If you want to get gold stickers, you just have to keep getting packs, the probability is low to pull gold stickers in any of the packs, so the more packs you get the more chances you'll get of finding a gold sticker.
